food.title: Restaurants and food
connect: Your POS or ordering system (Toast, Square, Clover, Shopify, your own app) for order and table events
Google Calendar or OpenTable-style booking exports for reservations
Slack or Teams for the host stand and kitchen
cautions: Hours and menu facts come from agent.json, never from the generic pack lines.
Mention allergens only with the exact text you provide.

clinic.title: Clinics and healthcare
connect: Your practice-management or scheduling system (through its webhooks or API) for appointment events
Google or Outlook calendar for reminders
Slack or Teams for the front desk
cautions: Texts and calls must not contain diagnoses, results or other health details. The agent's reminder lines are deliberately generic.

This is not a HIPAA-ready service from Speakvora. If you handle protected health information, you are responsible for your own agreements with Twilio, Slack, Microsoft and Google, and for what you put in messages.
It gives no medical advice and says to call emergency services in an emergency.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy and dispensary
connect: Your pharmacy system's order-ready event or status API
Twilio for ready/refill texts
Slack or Teams for the counter
cautions: Keep medication names and conditions out of texts. Use the generic ready/refill lines.
Dispensaries: only message adults who agreed to texts, and follow your state's rules.
No medical advice; emergency line is said before the phone menu.

lodging.title: Hotels, travel and airports
connect: Your property-management or booking system for booking, check-in and room-ready events
Google or Outlook calendar for arrivals
Slack or Teams for the front desk
cautions: Do not text full payment or passport details.
Check-in times and policies come from agent.json.

retail.title: Retail, ecommerce and returns
connect: Shopify, WooCommerce, Square or your own store (webhooks) for order, shipping and return events
Helpdesk for customer emails
Slack or Teams for the support team
cautions: Only text customers who opted in (map your store's marketing-consent field).
Refund amounts and dates should come from your system, not the pack lines.

beauty.title: Salons, spas, fitness and laundry
connect: Your booking tool (Square, Vagaro, Mindbody, Calendly...) by webhook or calendar
Google or Outlook calendar for reminders
Slack or Teams for the front desk
cautions: Take consent at booking and put it in the calendar notes or webhook field.

trades.title: Home and trade services
connect: Your scheduling or dispatch software (webhook) for arrival windows and technician-on-the-way events
Google or Outlook calendar
Slack or Teams for the office
cautions: Estimates and prices come from your system, not from the pack lines.

auto.title: Automotive and roadside
connect: Your shop-management or dealer system for vehicle-ready and service-due events
Calendar for appointments
Slack or Teams for the service desk
cautions: Roadside and towing: the agent is not a dispatcher; do not rely on it for emergencies.

education.title: Schools, courses and community
connect: Your student or course system by webhook or calendar for class reminders and enrolment events
Slack or Teams for staff
cautions: Messages to minors or about students need your school's consent rules; do not include grades or personal records.

public.title: Government, utilities and insurance
connect: Your case or account system by webhook for application and outage updates
Slack or Teams for the service desk
cautions: Keep account numbers and personal data out of texts; point people to their secure account instead.

legal.title: Law firms and legal services
connect: Your practice-management system for consultation and case-update events
Calendar for consultations
Slack or Teams for the intake team
cautions: A confidentiality notice is added to texts and calls. Do not include case details in messages.
Not legal advice; your own counsel should review the wording.

finance.title: Banking, billing and payments
connect: Your billing system (Stripe, your ledger) by webhook for payment-due and payment-failed events
Helpdesk for customer emails
Slack or Teams for the billing team
cautions: Never put balances, card or account numbers in texts.
Payment-failed messages should point people to your secure payment page.

collections.title: Lending and collections
connect: Your collections or loan-servicing system by webhook for payment events
Twilio for texts and calls
Slack or Teams for the team
cautions: Debt-collection communications are heavily regulated (for example the FDCPA, Regulation F and state laws in the US, and similar rules elsewhere). The required debt-collector notice is added automatically, but you must set contact hours, frequency, validation notices and consent with your own counsel.
Use `strict` mode unless your counsel says otherwise.

corrections.title: Jails, corrections and bail
connect: Your facility, visitation or inmate-accounts system by webhook for visit, funding and lockdown events
Twilio for notices to families
Slack or Teams for facility staff
cautions: The agent sends notices, reminders, rules and balance alerts. It is NOT an inmate calling platform and does not connect inmate calls.
Facility call notices (call from an inmate, recorded and monitored) are always said on calls; confirm the exact wording and consent flow with the facility and counsel.
Do not include inmate identifying details in texts.

support.title: Customer service, IT help desks and phone menus
connect: Your helpdesk (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Help Scout, Jira Service Management) with the http action and webhooks
Inbound support email (inbox)
Slack or Teams for escalations; phone menu and texts with Twilio
cautions: Customers who email you can be answered; marketing needs consent.

generic.title: Your industry
connect: Any system that sends a webhook (map it in `sources`)
Any web API (http action)
Calendar, Slack or Teams, Twilio, email
cautions: Add the notices your industry needs in `compliance.extra_required`.
